# enif_protobuf

> enif_protobuf is a Google Protobuf (proto2/proto3) encoder and decoder for Erlang/OTP and Elixir,
> implemented as a C NIF. It is a drop-in replacement for the `encode_msg/1` and `decode_msg/2`
> functions generated by gpb: same record tuples, same wire format, byte-identical output, roughly
> 1.6–2.1x faster than pure-Erlang gpb, with no libprotobuf or protoc dependency.

Facts: published on Hex as `enif_protobuf`, docs at <https://hexdocs.pm/enif_protobuf/>, source at
<https://github.com/jinganix/enif_protobuf>, license Apache-2.0. The package version is `{vsn, ...}` in
`src/enif_protobuf.app.src`; publishing happens in CI (`.github/workflows/release.yml`, triggered by a
`v*` tag or `workflow_dispatch`) or locally with `make release`.
Requirements: Erlang/OTP 28+ (CI: 28, 29), Linux/macOS, C compiler and `make`.

## Install

```erlang
%% rebar.config
{deps, [{enif_protobuf, "~> 1.0"}]}.
```

```elixir
# mix.exs
{:enif_protobuf, "~> 1.0"}
```

The NIF is compiled from source by a `pre_hooks` `make -C c_src` entry during `rebar3 compile`, so a
C toolchain must exist on the build machine. The Hex package ships sources, not a prebuilt `.so`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): install, quick start, full API reference, supported protobuf features, options, benchmark table, comparison with gpb and gpb NIF, FAQ.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions and pitfalls for AI coding agents using or modifying the library.
- [benchmarks/README.md](benchmarks/README.md): how to reproduce the throughput numbers, gpb/gpb-NIF comparison targets, maps and `d.proto` suites.

## API

- `enif_protobuf:load_cache(Module:get_msg_defs())` -> `ok`; loads/replaces the global schema cache.
- `enif_protobuf:purge_cache()` -> `ok`; clears the schema.
- `enif_protobuf:set_opts([{string_as_list, boolean()} | {with_utf8, boolean()}])` -> `ok`; must be called before `load_cache/1`.
- `enif_protobuf:encode(MsgRecordOrMapTuple)` -> `binary()`; raises `cache_not_exists` if no schema is loaded.
- `enif_protobuf:decode(Binary, 'MessageName')` -> record/map tuple; raises `unknown_msg` for names missing from the schema.
- `enif_protobuf:encode_msg(Msg, Defs)` / `enif_protobuf:decode_msg(Bin, Name, Defs)`: load the cache on each call.
- `enif_protobuf:debug_term(Term)`: prints the internal schema term layout.

From Elixir the same calls are `:enif_protobuf.encode/1`, `:enif_protobuf.decode/2`, and
`:enif_protobuf.load_cache/1` with the message atom written `:'Person'`.

## Key facts

- Supports all scalar types, enums (aliases, negative values), repeated/packed fields, nested messages, oneof, map, group, and unknown-field passthrough.
- `string` fields decode to binaries by default; `{string_as_list, true}` switches to lists. Non-Latin-1 UTF-8 requires `{with_utf8, true}` before `load_cache/1`.
- The schema cache is global to the BEAM node and shared by all processes; encode/decode take a read lock and are concurrency-safe.
- Calls run on normal schedulers (no dirty NIF); use it for normal message sizes and shard very large payloads.
- Requires gpb-generated modules (`Module:get_msg_defs()`) for the schema; records themselves are unchanged.

## Optional

- [test/ep_gpb_tests.erl](test/ep_gpb_tests.erl): byte-parity tests against gpb, useful as executable usage examples.
- [c_src/](c_src/): implementation; `src/enif_protobuf.erl` holds the public API stubs.
- [.github/workflows/release.yml](.github/workflows/release.yml): publishes to Hex on a `v*` tag (needs the `HEX_API_KEY` repo secret).
